This device controls media volume externally.

ManaMusicPlayer 1.8.0
A music player for standalone Android head units and Android 10+ devices. Not Android Auto or Android Automotive OS.

Set up storage, search, and manage queues only while parked. Do not use the screen while driving.

Playback controls come first. Other pages load on demand; lyrics and artwork wait for usable controls. Background loading waits another second after controls and library restoration, then the slideshow uses your interval. Background transitions run at up to 30 frames per second.

If the head unit has no system folder picker, choose Device music and allow music/audio access (called storage access on Android 10–12). Select several indexed folders inside ManaMusicPlayer. Unindexed USB music and separate lyric files need a compatible file manager or the system folder picker. Open file and background selection also try ordinary file managers. Folder-picker access is granted when you select a folder; no broad startup permission is needed. Some devices require a Music subfolder instead of a volume root.

Settings has left-side categories for language, appearance, backgrounds, playback, spectrum, lyrics, and folders. Choose transparent solid, dashed, rounded, or character borders. Move the artwork-first toolbar to any edge. Smaller screens combine Favorite and Details icons with volume to keep controls visible. Tap the time left of the seek bar to switch elapsed/remaining time; total duration stays on the right.

Lyrics use same-name LRC/TXT or embedded ID3 text first, then optional Kugou and NetEase searches in that order. The playing line is 20% larger by default with extra space; other lines stay compact. Dragging shows the selected time left of the center guide. Optionally release there to seek and play.

Customize supports private pictures, slideshow transitions and timing, blur, and light/dark tint. Follow car uses Android's system day/night signal. Classic colors share the same height scale across all bars. Fire stretches the complete three-color gradient from bottom to top of every bar, including short bars, with LED or smooth rendering.

Tap the upper-right photo for the original-resolution viewer. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, drag to pan, or use zoom and Fit.

MP3, AAC/M4A, FLAC, PCM WAV, Ogg Vorbis, and Ogg Opus depend on device decoders. WMA, DRM, DSD, and arbitrary codecs are not promised. Tags and artwork also depend on the device.

Rescans retain missing references and never delete music. Reconnect storage and rescan, or reselect a folder after revoked permission. Temporary grants may need reselection after restart. USB power, filesystems, and providers depend on the head unit.

Standard Android music widgets and Android/Bluetooth media keys control playback. Select ManaMusicPlayer in the widget if offered. Proprietary CAN/steering-wheel integration is not included. The last queue restores paused; nothing autoplays at boot or launch.
Choose music folders and manage your library only while parked. Removing a library reference never deletes your music files.

Playback connection failed: %1$s. Close and reopen ManaMusicPlayer to reconnect.
Android blocked background playback. Open ManaMusicPlayer and press Play again.
No compatible file picker could be opened. Device music can select folders from Android\'s indexed audio library instead.

This head unit did not provide Android\'s folder picker. Device music can request music access and let you select indexed music folders inside ManaMusicPlayer. USB audio appears only if Android has indexed it. Open file also tries an ordinary file manager. No extra permission at startup is needed for the usual folder-picker method.
No compatible picture picker or file manager could be opened. Selecting background pictures requires a file manager that supports Android file selection.
Android blocked file selection. Check the head unit\'s app restrictions, or use Device music for indexed audio.
Reading Android\'s audio library. Music files are not modified.
Choose folders to add or rescan. Unchecking here does not remove existing references or music files.

Android has not indexed any supported audio. Music access alone cannot make an unindexed USB drive appear. Try Open file with a compatible file manager, or ask the head-unit vendor to enable the system folder picker/media index.
Android cancelled the audio-library query. Please retry.

Device music uses Android\'s audio library instead of an external folder picker. Android 13+ requests music/audio access; Android 10–12 calls this storage access. ManaMusicPlayer reads indexed audio and does not modify music files. Permission is requested only when you choose this option, not when the app starts.
Music access was not granted. Choose Device music to retry or enable music/storage access in the app\'s Android settings. Your saved music references are kept.
Android is not offering the music-access prompt again. Open this app\'s Android settings, allow music/audio (or storage) access, then return here.
This head unit could not open Android\'s permission settings. Enable music/storage access for ManaMusicPlayer in the head unit\'s app settings.
The file picker did not return a document.
Embedded artwork is too large; showing the default cover.
Embedded artwork could not be decoded.
Embedded artwork is unavailable on this device or storage.
Android did not allow a media-volume change.
Library reference removed. Music files were not deleted.
References were removed, but Android could not release the old folder grant: %1$s
The provider returned a folder loop. Choose a different folder.

Single file repeats the current song. Folder repeats its saved folder, including subfolders. All selected folders repeats the folders you check below. Sequential follows queue order; Random shuffles it.\n\nOpening one file or a playlist keeps that queue until you change loop mode. Changes never start paused playback.

Add folders with Android\'s picker, or use Device music to grant audio access and select several indexed folders inside the app. Device music does not require a system file picker, but unindexed USB folders and separate lyric files are not included. Then choose any combination in Select music folders. Unchecking keeps saved references and music files.
Add and select at least one music folder in Settings.
No indexed music in the selected folders. Add or select a folder, then rescan.
No saved folder is available for this song. Add its folder or choose another loop mode.
This song is outside the selected folders. Select its folder in Settings or choose another loop mode.
The current song is outside the new selection. Playback is paused; press Play to start the selected music.
Show lyrics in the artwork area
Search online when local lyrics are missing

Local first: put a same-name .lrc or .txt beside the song, or use embedded ID3 lyric text. Select its folder to grant access to sidecar files; selecting only a song does not grant access to its neighbors. Timed lyrics follow playback and seeking; plain text can be scrolled.\n\nWhen enabled, online search sends song/artist names from tags or the filename to Kugou and, if needed, NetEase. Matching recognizes numbered filenames and song/artist combinations, ignoring unknown or sharing-site artist tags without changing your files. Returned durations are checked locally, and matching results are cached. Disabling Show lyrics cancels lyric lookup and restores artwork.
Local lyrics could not be read. Reconnect storage or select the music folder again.
Lyric search is unavailable. Playback is unaffected.
No lyrics found. Add the music folder to allow access to local lyric files.
Choose one or more pictures for the Customize theme.
Background pictures saved. Original files are unchanged.

Select up to 20 pictures; choosing again replaces the selection. One picture stays still, while multiple pictures cycle in the order returned by the picker. Blur 0 keeps pictures sharp; the preview updates when you release the slider. Tint adds black or white across the whole screen independently of blur. Original leaves the picture colors unchanged.\n\nPictures fill the screen with centered cropping. Resized copies are saved privately and remain after USB removal. Follow car uses Android\'s reported system theme.
Choose a picture smaller than 20 MiB.
This picture could not be decoded. Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
The background could not be loaded: %1$s
Could not save the background pictures. The previous selection is kept.

Defaults: a change every 5 seconds with a 2-second fade. Transition time is included in the interval and cannot exceed it. A shorter interval also shortens an overlong transition. The slideshow pauses when the app is not visible.

Frame song information, spectrum, lyrics, seeking, playback, navigation and volume. Choose solid, dashed, rounded, or repeated-character borders. Interiors stay transparent, without a color mask or shadow. Turn off for unframed controls. Existing background tint settings are unchanged.
Use Customize theme to configure pictures
Show audio spectrum beside song information

Classic and Fire each have three editable color anchors at the bottom, middle, and top. Colors blend smoothly between those anchors in LED segments, solid bars, and Line mode. Fire defaults to gold, orange, and red from bottom to top. LED keeps transparent gaps; Smooth bars removes the gaps, not the gradient. Theme uses the theme accent.\n\nAnalysis uses this player\'s decoded audio only while this panel is visible and playback is active. Redraw rate controls visual smoothing; audio analysis is capped at 30 updates per second. This is a visualization, not an equalizer or a calibrated meter. Outputs that bypass PCM processing may not provide spectrum data.
Main player time display (also tap the time)
Drag lyrics and release to play

For timed lyrics, drag the desired line to the center and release to seek and start playing there, even if paused. Off by default to avoid accidental seeks. With this off, or for plain text, dragging only scrolls; automatic following resumes after five seconds. Use while parked.
